surprises: MY FIRST 6.3 INSTRUMENT WAS INVALID AND I CAUGHT IT BEFORE REPORTING. I compared within- minus cross-firm MEAN affinity across view 1 and the fused output and read a collapse from 0.1713 to 0.0000175. That comparison is not sound: SNF row-normalises to a transition matrix, so the fused maximum is 0.0048 against view 1's 1.0, and the difference measures the normalisation as much as the separation. Replaced with rank AUC, which is invariant under any monotone rescale. THE FINDING SURVIVED THE CORRECTION (0.7429 -> 0.5114) but would have been reported for the wrong reason, and a reader could have refuted my number while the conclusion stood.

A THIRD DEFECT OF MINE, CAUGHT IN THIS PROOF BEFORE IT SHIPPED: artifacts_produced took commit_or_etag from `git rev-parse HEAD` at generation time. In a SHARED worktree that is whatever seat committed last -- it resolved to another lane's commit (a8287f97a7) and pinned ALL FOUR artifacts to a commit none of them live at. A pin from HEAD names the tree's state, not the artifact's. Now DERIVED per artifact with `git log -1 -- <path>`, and the builder REFUSES an uncommitted artifact rather than pinning it to something. This is the same shape as the row-schema provenance defect that was refused earlier tonight, reproduced by me in the document whose job is to be checkable.

MY FIRST ENCODING WAS JOINTLY REFUSED AND BOTH DEFECTS WERE MINE. (1) It defined the output on the co-measured 4,147 -- the intersection in a different coat -- while carrying the union only in masks and prose; the union-not-intersection clause binds the OUTPUT. (2) All three of its AUCs were computed over 1,820 cohort entities while the AUC block printed no denominator, so a reader would have taken them for the locked 1,941; my own artifact carried in_fused_domain 1,820 two fields away. 4.0.0_SA_CRO~X found (2). Both corrected at @1f5d4f6136; the refused encoding is preserved.

A MECHANISM CLAIM OF MINE IS WITHDRAWN: the first encoding asserted that SNF cross-diffusion let a near-uniform view flatten a discriminating one. I did not test it. Cause is recorded OPEN pending an independent MISSING-treatment control. What is measured is the OUTCOME; asserting a mechanism beside a measurement is how a plausible story gets certified as a finding.

THE HEADLINE IS A NEGATIVE RESULT AND IT IS REPORTED AS ONE: sec 6.3 EVALUATED, result FALSE on both frames. The fused output PASSES its discrimination gate AND loses the firm signal -- two different properties, neither folded into the other. First evidence from run 1: not a project failure and not a final verdict on the method.
